name: week
title: This week in the rooms
subtitle: What needs the front desk or a doctor, worst first. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Procedures without signed consent, expired referrals, results waiting, missing provider numbers, overdue letters, registrations, recalls and old accounts.
sections.sql: select issue, patient, who as doctor, on_date, detail from v_attention order by severity, on_date nulls first

sections.title: Procedures in the next 30 days
sections.sql: select planned_on, surgeon, hospital, patient, procedure, to_char(gap_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as est_gap, case when ifc_signed_on is not null then 'signed' when ifc_given_on is not null then 'sent, unsigned' else 'NONE' end as consent from v_procedures where status in ('planned', 'booked') and planned_on <= current_date + 30 order by planned_on

sections.title: Bookings in the next 14 days on a referral that has run out or is about to
sections.sql: select on_date, practitioner, patient, kind, cover, valid_until from v_referral_cover where status = 'booked' and on_date between current_date and current_date + 14 and cover <> 'valid' order by on_date

name: referrers
title: Who sends us patients
subtitle: New referrals by referring doctor: the last 12 months against the 12 before.

sections.title: Referrers
sections.sql: select name as referrer, practice, last_12m, prior_12m, last_referral_on, days_since from v_referrer_trend where last_12m + prior_12m > 0 order by last_12m desc, prior_12m desc

sections.title: Letters still owed to them
sections.sql: select referrer, patient, practitioner, kind, due_on, days_late from v_letters_owed order by due_on

name: compliance
title: Compliance and money
subtitle: Provider numbers, registrations, retention and open accounts.

sections.title: Locations worked without a provider number
sections.sql: select practitioner, location, first_booking from v_provider_gaps

sections.title: Registration and indemnity
sections.sql: select name, role, registration_expires_on, registration_days, indemnity_expires_on, indemnity_days from v_registrations order by least(registration_days, indemnity_days)

sections.title: Records with a disposal date
sections.sql: select code, name, last_service_on, keep_until, disposal_on, case when disposal_on < keep_until then 'TOO EARLY' else 'ok' end as retention_check from v_retention where disposal_on is not null

sections.title: Open accounts by age
sections.sql: select bucket, count(*) as accounts, to_char(sum(owing_cents) / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as owing from v_debtors group by bucket order by bucket
